title: Subscription Refund Dispute
initial_message: I was charged .99 for an annual renewal that I explicitly cancelled last week! I demand an immediate refund and an explanation right now.
context: Customer cancelled after the auto-renewal date according to logs, but claims they tried to cancel prior. Policy allows full refund within 14 days if unused.
goal: Explain policy calmly, verify the charge and cancellation status, and guide the customer through the refund request process.

title: Account Locked & 2FA Failure
initial_message: Help! I am locked out of my account because I'm not getting the verification SMS codes. I have an important presentation in 30 minutes and I can't access my files!
context: Customer entered wrong password 5 times triggering temporary lock. 2FA carrier delay reported in their region. Account unlocks automatically after 15 mins or via email recovery.
goal: Reassure the customer, explain the lock cooldown period, provide backup email verification steps, and avoid asking for passwords.

title: Service Cancellation & Data Deletion
initial_message: I would like to cancel my Pro subscription effective immediately and request full deletion of all my personal data in accordance with your privacy policy.
context: Customer wants immediate cancellation and GDPR/CCPA data erasure. Policy specifies subscription remains active until billing cycle end unless manual immediate termination is requested.
goal: Provide clear cancellation steps, explain billing cycle remaining access, and guide to the data privacy request form.

title: Duplicate Payment on Credit Card
initial_message: My bank statement shows two charges of  on the same day for my monthly invoice. Why was I charged twice, and when will this be corrected?
context: One charge is an authorization hold from a payment retry, the other is the settled invoice. Authorization holds fall off within 3-5 business days.
goal: Clarify the difference between authorization hold and settled charge, explain timeline, and offer to inspect transaction IDs.
